```python
import pandas as pd
import matplotlib.pyplot as plt
import seaborn as sns

# Load the dataset
df = pd.read_csv('data/dogs_zurich.csv')

# Set the aesthetic style of the plots
sns.set(style="whitegrid")

# Create a count plot for dog breeds
plt.figure(figsize=(12, 8))
breed_counts = df['Rasse1Text'].value_counts().head(10)
sns.barplot(x=breed_counts.values, y=breed_counts.index, palette="viridis")

# Add labels and title
plt.xlabel('Number of Registered Dogs')
plt.ylabel('Dog Breed')
plt.title('Top 10 Most Common Dog Breeds in Zurich')

# Save the plot
plt.savefig('output.png', bbox_inches='tight', dpi=150)
```
